description: Show the card X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Slack display when a page is shared: its title, description, image (with the image's real size in pixels, read from the image itself), image description, X card type and og:url — each check pass / improve / fix with how to fix it. It fetches the page and the image its og:image names as our crawler (MakerRadarBot), after each host's robots.txt, and stores nothing; what it reads is the site's own, unverified. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: preview_social_card

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Preview a page's social card
